name: Vörðr
body:
VÖRÐR
CR 5

This ghostly figure appears to be a young woman clad in simple garb and carrying a leather satchel from her belt.

XP 1,600
LN Medium outsider (native, incorporeal)
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +11

DEFENSE

AC 19, touch 19, flat-footed 15 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +4 deflection)
hp 45 (6d10+12)
Fort +7, Ref +6, Will +7
Defensive Abilities incorporeal, uncanny dodge; SR 18

OFFENSE

Speed fly 60 ft. (good)
Melee incorporeal touch (2d6+4) or longsword +10/+5 (1d8+6/19-20) when manifested
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks disorienting strike (DC 14)
Spell-Like Abilities (CL 6th; concentration +10)

At will—augury, dancing lights, deathwatch, invisibility, mending, prestidigitation, warp wood (DC 16)
1/day—glyph of warding (DC 17), locate creature, make whole, prayer, shield other, status, tree stride

STATISTICS

Str -, Dex 18, Con 14, Int 14, Wis 15, Cha 18
Base Atk +6; CMB +10; CMD 20 (24 when manifested)
Feats Improved Initiative, Dodge, Mobility
Skills Acrobatics +13, Bluff +13, Diplomacy +13, Disguise +13, Escape Artist +13, Perception +11, Sleight of Hand +13, Stealth +13
Languages Common, Elven, Sylvan

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Avenger (Su)

When a creature vörðr has selected as being under its protection is slain, it must succeed on a DC 15 Will save or be transformed into a revenant at the next sunset, bound to hunt down the murderer of its charge. It does not have the self-loathing trait of typical revenants. If the revenant body is destroyed, the vörðr also dies (DC 15 Fortitude negates). On a successful save, or if the murderer is slain, the vörðr returns to life in its normal form at the next dawn.

Disorienting Strike (Su)

Creatures struck by a vörðr’s incorporeal touch also become dazed for 1d4 rounds (DC 17 Will negates). A creature that fails its save also takes a -10 penalty on Survival checks to avoid getting lost and moves at half speed in overland travel due to its uncertainty and meandering path; this effect lasts for 1d4 hours. A creature that saves becomes immune to that vörðr’s disorienting strike for 24 hours. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Manifest (Su)

As a swift action, a vörðr can manifest a physical body or return to being incorporeal. When manifested, it gains a Strength score equal to its Dexterity and a land speed of 30 feet but loses its fly speed. Her body is solid enough to feel but still intangible within, making her immune to additional damage from critical hits and precision-based damage (unless dealt by a ghost touch weapon). She can draw forth a longsword from her satchel and wield it with proficiency. On a critical hit with her sword, the target must save against her disorienting strike.

Rejuvenate (Sp)

By moving into the space of a living creature and remaining there for 1 full round, a vörðr can grant that creature the benefit of one of the following spells: cure serious wounds, lesser restoration, remove blindness/deafness, remove curse, remove disease, neutralize poison. It can use this ability up to three times per day, but it can’t affect any creature more than once per day.

Tree Gatekeeper (Su)

When a vörðr uses her tree stride spell-like ability, she enter an elm, ash, or linden tree and hold open a gateway that can be used by up to 5 additional willing creatures of her choice to step through it and transport to another elm or linden tree of the vörðr’s choice within range. This use of tree stride ends when 5 creatures have used it or the vörðr herself leaves the tree, whether exiting the original tree or the destination tree.

ECOLOGY

Environment any
Organization solitary
Treasure standard
